Sheena is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A gunslinger from the wilderness, devoted to justice. Raised in the wild, she developed a rugged purity and acquired exceptional gun skills under her father’s tutelage. Her only kin struck down by illness, her father bequeathed unto her a special gun on his deathbed. This weapon, an ancient relic and one of only two in existence, selects its own wielder. Left alone in the world, she embarked on a journey with no set destination, determined to honor her father’s dying wish: to prevent her gun’s counterpart from falling into the hands of villains.
